note: Hard payload ceilings per input route and request path (subject plugin plan, decisions S6 and S14). Bytes of system prompt + prompt + response schema, excluding images. First-request ceilings are the P0 maxima plus the headroom tested in the 2026-11-11 payload experiment (+8,368 B, of which +2,956 B schema; docs/PAYLOAD_EXPERIMENT_2026-11-11.md). Other paths keep their P0 maxima. Raising a ceiling requires a plan change and a fresh live speed comparison. Raised 2026-11-12 by 15-30 B schema on the paths the model-number scale fix (0-12) grows: a one-off exception to S6 granted by the owner (no live comparison), because the change only lengthens an enum. Fallback-outline ceilings raised 2026-11-12 to the measured maxima with the four number-line recipes adopted (+917 to +925 B total, +60 B schema), owner-approved under S6: the fallback outline stays far below the first-request sizes tested live at +8,368 B. Raised 2026-11-14 by +2,000 B (total and schema) on the fallback-outline, later-section, section-repair and first-section-retry paths, owner-approved under S6 (math expressiveness plan Q5): these ceilings sat at their measured maxima with no room for the next components (the number-line and function-plot extensions add about 1 to 1.2 KB), and the raised requests stay far below the first-request sizes tested live at +8,368 B. First-request and practice ceilings are unchanged. The live speed comparison is folded into the next gate, which covers the practice invitation (#81) and the two extensions.
